text:
jamie: quick sync after the rollout postmortem  we need a clearer priority model for auto-fallbacks during canaries. who gets the final say?
neel: my vote: orchestrator still has final authority, but allow runtime to preempt for short-lived emergencies (safety preempt).
anya: preempt ok but only if it writes an immutable "preempt lease" so orchestrator can see it and not immediately fight back.
sam: +1. runtime preempt lease should include lease_id, reason, expiry_ts, fallback_level, and fallback_score.
jamie: what is fallback_score? new metric?
neel: computed at runtime from weighted signals: latency_z, error_rate, model_confidence_drop. normalized to 0-100. threshold decides action.
anya: important: keep threshold conservative for canaries -> we don't want noisy signals to flip models. propose canary thresholds 25% lower sensitivity than prod.
lucy: proposal: fallback_priority = {ORCHESTRATOR: 3, PREEMPT_LEASE: 2, RUNTIME_LOCAL: 1}. orchestrator overrides lower ones unless lease is active and has CRITICAL tag.
sam: add CRITICAL tag to lease if the runtime sees an unsafe condition (OOM, security failure).
jamie: what about cooldowns? we saw oscillation in the postmortem.
neel: two-tier cooldown: local runtime cooldown (rolling window, e.g., 45s) and a cluster-held cooldown ledger with leases (persisted to etcd) with TTL (5-15m). orchestrator respects ledger.
anya: ledger should be sharded by cohort to avoid hot keys. small shard key = cohort_id mod N.
lucy: interface: runtime emits "FallbackEvent" lines to telemetry with fields: decision_id, lease_id?, source, fallback_level, fallback_score, reason_code, cohort_id, samples, p50, p95, ttl_ms. flat json-lines.
sam: reason_code enum: LATENCY_P99, SERVE_ERRORS, OOM, MODEL_CONFIDENCE_LOSS, KVS_DEGRADATION. no freeforms.
jamie: can we include a human-friendly short reason for oncall? optional string field notes.
neel: yes optional notes ok. but default should be enum.
anya: orchestration API sketch: 
```
// idempotent
rpc RequestLease(RequestLeaseReq) returns (RequestLeaseResp);
message RequestLeaseReq { string cohort_id; string lease_id; int32 desired_ttl_s; int32 priority; string reason_code; }
```
Orchestrator grants or rejects.
lucy: for emergency fast-path, runtime can create a local fallback without lease but must emit the event and attempt RequestLease async.
sam: simulation thought: run a fault-injection sweep where runtime preempts frequently and ensure orchestrator grants only when consistent across shards. need a harness.
jamie: agree. add simulation to action items.
neel: also add "burn-in" guard: during initial canary ramp (first X minutes or Y requests) only allow INFO events; ACTIONABLE events need a quorum across N instances before action. quorum = 3 by default.
anya: quorum across availability zones makes sense to avoid AZ noise.
lucy: add actionability enum: INFO, ACTIONABLE, CRITICAL. runtime acts only on ACTIONABLE/CRITICAL but requires quorum when in burn-in.
sam: operational note: SetFallback RPC is useful but must be authenticated and auditable. logs stored with decision_id and actor (svc user).
jamie: decision_id must be globally unique (e.g., unixms-cohort-random). store it in telemetry for traceability.
neel: also think about staged degrade: FALLBACK_LEVELS = {NONE, SOFT_DEGRADE, HARD_DEGRADE, BLOCK}. SOFT could drop to smaller model; HARD uses cached responses; BLOCK returns 503.
anya: prefer names SIMPLE -> REDUCED -> FALLBACK_MODEL -> REJECT but semantics are same. add mapping doc.
lucy: action items: (1) neel + sam: write the RequestLease proto + lease semantics by Tue EOD (2) anya: document burn-in quorum rules + shard plan by Mon (3) jamie: add simulation harness ticket and owner (sam) (4) lucy: telemetry json-lines schema PR.
sam: will start simulation skeleton today. target: replay 1M reqs with injected p99 spikes.
jamie: one more thing: avoid silent automatic UNDOs. once orchestrator flips back, require a stable window before re-enabling higher-quality models. default stable window = 10m.
neel: make stable window configurable per-cohort and exposed in canary config.
anya: also require humans-in-the-loop for major model family downgrades (why we have audit requirement).
lucy: ops-bot note: canary-run 1845678800 finished; anomalies flagged in a-zone. link: https://dash/reports/1845678800
ops-bot: incidentbot: fallback_lease granted cohort=canary-007 lease_id=1845678901-lease reason=KVS_DEGRADATION ttl_s=900
sam: perfect. i'll wire simulation to emit the same telemetry format so we can validate ingestion.
jamie: ok closing with timeline: prototypes this sprint, simulation before next canary, followup check-in Thu. thanks."
